site: Ball Creek weir house #9, Coweeta Hydrologic Laboratory, Otto NC (EDI knb-lter-cwt.3037/19)
fork_identity_evidence: NHD/GNIS named reaches: 'Ball Creek' centroid (-83.4451,35.0466) SOUTH fork; 'Shope Fork' centroid (-83.4496,35.0589) NORTH fork. WS18(Grady Branch) + WS27 EML centroids both fall inside the SOUTH (Ball Creek) polygon.
reconciliation: Ball Creek = SOUTH fork = 7.24 km2 on Copernicus GLO-30 (the mesh-acquisition delineation DEM). Ball(7.24)+Shope(8.41)+intervening = CWTBASIN. GLO-30 whole basin 18.06 under-captures the surveyed 21.85 km2 by ~17%; Ball Creek is ~40% of the GLO-30 basin (the smaller of the two comparable main forks), ~33% of the documented 21.85. Scaled for the DEM under-capture the true Ball Creek fork is ~8.7 km2.
